title: Mito Health Passes One Million Lab Tests, Expands to Seven Categories of Preventive Health Testing
summary: Mito Health has run more than one million lab tests and now offers seven categories of preventive health testing: lab panels, at-home kits, at-home blood draws, imaging, whole genome sequencing, specialty kits, and multi-cancer early detection.
body_markdown:
Today, Mito Health announced it has run more than one million lab tests and has expanded beyond blood testing into seven categories of preventive health testing, giving customers one place to order diagnostics without insurance, a referral, or a surprise bill.


For its first two years, Mito Health served people ordering 100-plus-biomarker longevity panels. Today, its customers order tests for fertility planning, strength and body composition, baseline markers for chronic diseases, nutrient and heavy-metal screening, inherited disease risk, and tuberculosis testing required for school enrollment. Many might be between insurance plans or want to order tests directly rather than wait for approval.


Mito Health’s entire product catalog now includes:


- **Lab tests:** more than 1,000[individual tests and panels](https://mitohealth.com/shop/directory) , from single markers to 180-plus biomarker panels
- **At-home test kits:** shipped across 50 states, nationwide
- **At-home blood draws:** available in 35 states
- **Imaging and scans:** DEXA body composition and whole-body MRI, with coronary artery calcium scoring and VO2 max scheduled
- **[Whole genome sequencing](https://mitohealth.com/blog/whole-genome-sequencing-mito-health) :** 3x and 30x coverage
- **Specialty kits:** Gut microbiome analysis and H. pylori breath testing
- **Multi-cancer early detection:** liquid biopsy testing


Supplements and prescriptions are planned and priced the same way.


Customers can walk into partner draw sites nationwide or request an at-home blood draw in 35 states. Mito Health prices diagnostics at cost and is supported by a[$9 per month membership](https://mitohealth.com/membership) rather than markups, upsells or commissions. HSA and FSA funds are accepted.


“People rarely need just one kind of test,” said Rhonda Collins, FNP-C, who supports clinical operations at Mito Health. “Someone looking at fertility, or at family history, often needs bloodwork and imaging and sometimes genetics. Having those in one place means fewer places to get lost.”


“We wanted transparent preventive health prices, at cost, with one health membership,” said Kenneth Lou, Co-founder and Chief executive of Mito Health. “We earn the same whether someone buys a lot, a little or nothing at all. That is what lets us tell a customer the most useful thing is often to test less, not more.”


The full catalog is available at[mitohealth.com](https://mitohealth.com/shop) .


## About Mito Health


Mito Health is a direct-to-consumer diagnostics marketplace offering transparent, at-cost preventive health testing across lab panels, at-home kits, imaging, whole genome sequencing and early cancer detection. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, Mito Health has run more than one million lab tests and is supported by a $9 per month membership rather than product markups.
